mechanism: Hold era_archive_snapshots with ACCESS EXCLUSIVE so closeEra completes snapshot reads and blocks before snapshot persistence and before final Era CAS.
Commit direct SQL UPDATE against snapshot-contributing eras.story while closeEra is blocked.
The UPDATE does not change eras.updated_at and does not change eras.content_revision.
Release the archive-table gate and allow closeEra to finish.
Observe CLOSED Era with persisted snapshot retaining the pre-mutation story while the live Era contains the mutation committed before close completion.

rootCause: The CLOSURE snapshot contains mutable fields from the eras row, including story and other Era metadata.

Migration 0015 advances content_revision for child tables and referenced product mutations, but it does not provide a database guard for ordinary direct mutations of snapshot-contributing eras fields.
eras.updated_at has a default but is not database-maintained on every UPDATE.
closeEra does not hold a row lock on the Era before snapshot construction.
Therefore a direct Era-row mutation can commit after snapshot construction while both final CAS guards remain unchanged.
consequence: The frozen remediation candidate can accept a CLOSURE snapshot that is stale relative to an Era-row mutation committed before closure completes.
